methodSections.heading: Octopus
steps: Massage the octopus with salt and lightly beat it with a rolling pin to soften up the tissue.
Cook in a large pot of heavily salted boiling water for 10 to 15 minutes or until soft when poked with a fork.
Remove from the cooking water and place in ice water to cool. Cut into 2cm portions.

methodSections.heading: Rice
steps: Mix the garlic, ginger and sake into the rice, add water and cook in a rice cooker or on a medium heat in a saucepan until the liquid has evaporated.

methodSections.heading: Serving
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, Sriracha, honey and sesame oil together.
Divide the rice into four bowls and place the tuna, octopus, pea shoots, onions, and tomato on top.
Place a few dollops of the Poke Sauce on top and garnish with some greens.
